source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Determine if you think the water-service delivered food or water to citizens while under a boil-water alert. 3. If so, did they also make phone calls to verify they served food or water which was not boiled under the warning? 4. If so, did the businesses verify that the water being used for the food service in the future would be boiled under the warning? 5. If so, did the municipality continue to have restaurants turn off their water without knowing if they served food under the warning? 6. Did they ever receive a police or fire report that accurately indicates that the water was turned off earlier than needed? 7. If not, did they continue to have the restaurant turn off the water for the first time?

Required Data Items For a Municipal Water-Quality Test

1. The municipality should be contacted immediately. The location and date of the test
